status: draft — increment 2; gap-durations ratified by Perry 2026-06-09; Smith-Spring retained as an intentional non-edge
coordinate_note: display.x/.y are schematic [0,1] coords copied from tools/map-viewer/data/positions.yaml (1200x800 SVG viewBox, origin top-left). They exist for rendering only. They have NO real-world scale and are NOT used to compute `days` — travel-times come solely from attested prose.

edges.seasonal: the pass closes ~6 weeks at the late-winter snow
edges.source: Three days under cliff and a day in scree

edges.note: southern carved descent from the cloud forest to the Ndjadi floodplains
edges.source: The carved descent from the cloud forest takes four days for a loaded llama and six for a sick one

edges.note: western carved descent from the cloud forest to the Oravan coast; same general descent figure
edges.source: The carved descent from the cloud forest takes four days for a loaded llama and six for a sick one

edges.note: north shore to south shore — the across-Basin sail

edges.seasonal: the khatti letters of credit settle at Tavakh-Qarat in the cool season
edges.note: the full Irrah desert belt, from the Basin's east-shore port to the southeastern frankincense coast
edges.source: A horizontal swathe of desert from the Basin's east shore to the frankincense coast, sixty days under good water and never under bad

edges.seasonal: piloted transit only; a keel may wait days at the western anchorage for a fair tide
edges.note: the piloted narrows transit only; the unattested archipelago→port open-water leg is deliberately not weighted
edges.source: A keel takes the narrows in a day under an Oravan pilot

edges.seasonal: impassable at flood; two of four seasons crossable only by a seized bank
edges.note: cliff-edge-to-delta descent reading off Lam-Chen (4d) and Qollari cliff-roads (4–6d); the ford is the low-water window at the foot
edges.source: The descent from the cliff-edge to the delta floor is four days in the low-water season, the last of them at the ford

edges.note: north-east rim coasting hop; a chord of the 3-day across-Basin diameter
edges.source: Tavakh-Qarat to Halani-Tamu is a single day along the north-east shore

edges.note: southern-rim coasting hop to the SE-margin metal door
edges.source: Dzong-Tamu sits on the Basin's south-eastern margin, a day's coasting around the southern rim from Ki-Mbuhari

gaps.reason: Intentional non-edge: canon forbids the traverse. The iron turns back at the buffer and the salt turns back at the buffer ('the place past which neither people goes'). The only figure is the 3-league ore-flow, not a route time. Modeled as a turn-back hub, not a crossing.
